ios.desc:
See it. Find it. Buy it.

Point your camera at anything — shoes, kitchen gadgets, electronics, food on a shelf. iBuy's AI identifies every product in the frame and finds real listings from real retailers.

You're at a friend's place. You spot a lamp you love. Snap a photo — iBuy tells you what it is and where to buy it.

WHAT YOU GET
• Instant product identification from any photo
• Multiple products recognized in a single image
• Real prices from real retailers — not just search links
• Location-aware results from stores near you
• Smart across categories — fashion, electronics, food, beauty, home, automotive, and more
• Budget, quality, and premium options side-by-side

HOW IT WORKS

Take a photo or pick one from your library
iBuy identifies every product in the image
Tap any product to see prices, details, and where to buy
Shop directly from the app

PRIVACY
Photos are sent securely to our AI for identification and aren't stored or shared.
